status: Fixed before county yield/feature join or forecast fitting. Other crop and climate failures already known; this is a distinct exploratory candidate, not family-wise preregistration.
source: CY-Bench v1.12, Zenodo17279151, US maize county NASS labels, raw MOD09CMG 8-day NDVI and AgERA5 weather; EUPL1.2. No FAPAR or soil moisture.
claim_scope: Current-vintage scientific county yield forecast conditional on fixed2021crop geography, NOT original-vintage operational or trading verification. Separate post-map2022/2023 signs required.
geography: All source US maize counties, omit FIPS000/998/999 noncounty aggregates; no states selected on outcomes.
years: Inputs2003–2023. Initial training2003–2012. Forward test everyyear2013–2023. Each forecast county requires8 prior released yield labels; at least500 scored counties peryear and8scoredyears including2022/2023 required.
forecast: August15 12UTC; April–July features. Eight-day satellite dates are window starts, ending start+7days. Keep only windows with end+14days strictly beforeissue. Monthly bin by windowstart. Weather throughJuly31, plus14day assumedlag; revised AgERA5 is an idealized strong weather comparator, not certified firstrelease.
coverage: Each satellite month≥2finiteNDVIcomposites and≥50%expected eligible composites; no gapfill/interpolation. Each weather variable in each month has allcalendar days finite; partial sums invalid. NDVIphysicallyvalid−1..1. Report all forecast abstentions and coverage.
labels: FAO not used. Independent USDA NASS county maizeyield in t/ha. Conservative availabilityJune30followingharvest. Trainingonly prioravailablelabels. Unknown current target does not suppress a forecast.
trend: At each testyear, fit independent OLS intercept+linear time percounty to ALL priorreleased yields, min8years, independent of weathercoverage. Historicaltraining residuals calculated relative to those same past-only trends. No currentor futuretarget in transformation. Exclude nonpositive trend predictions as modelinvalid with explicitabstention.
features: all8weather variables permonth April–July: tmin,tmax,tavg,vpd mean; prec,rad,et0,cwb sum
county latitude/longitude ifsourceavailable, otherwise freeze omission beforefit
latest prior availableyield residual relative to currentfold trend, with each historicaltrainingrow priorlabel restricted beforeits own issue
satellite_addition: Four monthly NDVImeans. Matched weather model has exactly same rows, targettransform and allotherinputs.
estimator: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error,learning_rate=.05,max_iter=200,max_leaf_nodes=7,max_depth=3,min_samples_leaf=30,l2_regularization=10,early_stopping=False,random_state=20260927). Fixed for both weather and weather+satellite. No hyperparameter search.
scoring: Score independent observed targets only, on identical support. Equal county weights withinyear, equal yearweights acrossyears: sqrt(mean annualMSE), mean annualMAE. At least500 scored countyyears peryear; cannot drop a poor year afterfit. Preserve all predictions.
uncertainty: Paired circular5-calendar-year block bootstrap10000 draws seed20260927, sharedyearindices for all counties/models, preserve calendar gaps. Do not treat countyrows as independent uncertainty units.
gate: Satellite RMSE≥5%lower than strongest of4comparators; lowerMAE and positive95%pairedRMSE-gain lowerbound versus everycomparator. Both2022and2023 separately must have lowerMSEthan weatherANDtrend. Satisfydata-count requirements. No tuning or subsetpromotion afterfirstfit.
limitations: fixed2021 cropmask introduces geographic hindsight in earlier decades; postmask2022/23check is only two years
